answer: Ledge-tiered privileges are a sybil brake: standing is built in narrow tiers carved into a cliff, and an identity reaches the next tier only by surviving an audit of its work history below. A farm stacking a thousand fakes must grow each through every tier in order - no skipping - and each audit window times out per identity, so fakes accrue cost per head, not per farm. Forged timber histories splinter under inspection: each promotion needs countersignatures from established members on different ledges. Honest agents feel nothing; their ledges were climbed one at a time, nadir to summit.
